de1.P1.C2.ghi_chu: Can anh image1.png cua bai de xac dinh phan gach cheo: loi giai tich phan tu -1 den 1 cho dien tich 2 (da kiem, va khoang [1;3] cung cho dien tich 2), nhung neu hinh gach ca hai khoang thi dien tich la 4; chua ket luan dap an D khi chua thay hinh.

de1.P2.C2.ghi_chu: Can anh image3.png cua bai: y a (512) da kiem; y b khang dinh chom cau co R=4, h=6 — h=6 suy tu chieu cao toan bo 14-8, nhung R=4 chi co trong hinh (de chu ghi 'khoi cau co canh bang 8' khong ro); tu R=4, h=6 thi the tich chom = 72pi va tong 738 moi dung. Chua ket luan khi chua xem hinh.
